newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse first tier keeps centre-stage.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse first tier keeps centre-stage.

text.p: The first tier of the Bucharest stock exchange dominated trading on Monday, taking 89 percent of turnover, but the price picture in this section was mixed, reflecting demand and supply.
Top performer Azomures fertiliser maker had a special trade in 155,308 shares, which helped it close 100 lei higher at 3,800.
"The deal, like others before it, involved foreign interest," said one broker, declining to elaborate.
The special trade -- a large deal struck outside the market and then reported to the stock exchange -- delayed release of the bourse final results by about two hours.
"Antibiotice was a nice stock to speculate today," another broker said. "It opened low at 4,100 and closed a lot higher at 5,750, so I made nice profits."
Antibiotice is a first-tier pharmaceuticals firm.
The other first-tier firm in the sector, Terapia, closed 150 lei lower at 5,850. Traders said buyers were reluctant to pay more for the stock which they considered already expensive.
High-cap chemical plant Oltchim closed 50 lei weaker at 2,450 under supply outrunning demand.

Monday saw another special deal in second-tier Policolor dye maker, involving 50,000 shares worth a total 220 million lei. Policolor picked up 250 lei and ended at 4,450. Its turnover was a total 862.5 million.
"Policolor was the only fine performer on the second tier, where activity was otherwise dull," a trader said.
Nine second-tier stocks, including newcomer Sinteza chemical plant, had no trade and three companies were suspended pending release of their 1996 financial results.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, slipped by 0.3 and 0.06 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index dropped by 0.6 percent to 3,361.21 points.
